name: What metrics should insurance agents track to measure AEO success?
description: Track featured snippets, 'People Also Ask' visibility, voice search impressions, click-through rates, organic traffic to answer pages, and lead conversions.

mainEntity.name: What metrics should insurance agents track to measure AEO success?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insurance agents should track several key metrics to measure AEO success. These include the number of featured snippets acquired, visibility in 'People Also Ask' boxes, voice search impressions, and click-through rates from these enhanced search features. Additionally, monitoring organic traffic increases to specific FAQ or answer-focused pages, lead generation from these pages, and conversion rates (e.g., quote requests, policy applications) provides a comprehensive view of AEO's impact on business growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track featured snippets, 'People Also Ask' visibility, voice search impressions, click-through rates, organic traffic to answer pages, and lead conversions.
